Details
  • Paper: Segment Anything in High Quality, NeurIPS 2023, 2023-06-02
  • Original code: https://github.com/SysCV/sam-hq at e696978d6035
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/lkeab/hq-sam/blob/09b02a333b37772133eff3997bdba997867374b7/README.md (license: apache-2.0); code: https://github.com/SysCV/sam-hq/blob/e696978d60352dc9a26b12631cd91781502c6546/LICENSE
  • Training data: the HQ head is trained on HQSeg-44K (six existing fine-mask datasets, per the paper; their terms were not checked) on top of SAM's frozen weights (SA-1B, under the SA-1B research licence)
  • Kernel libraries: dpt_fused
  • Variants: sam-hq-vit-b, sam-hq-vit-l, sam-hq-vit-h
  • Outputs: pred_masks, iou_scores
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized inside to the fixed encoder input 1024x1024 (the default export size)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): sam-hq-vit-b 1080x1920 (0.4 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); sam-hq-vit-l 1080x1920 (0.8 GiB peak allocated, 1.1 reserved); sam-hq-vit-h 1080x1920 (1.5 GiB peak allocated, 1.9 reserved)
  • sam-hq-vit-b 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 33 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 39 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sam-hq-vit-l 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 33 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 53 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sam-hq-vit-h 1024x1024, first call: portable + torch.compile 42 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 69 s (ONNX + engine).
  • sam-hq-vit-b original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-b original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-l original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-l original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-h original (fp32) 1024x1024: upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-h original 1024x1024: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; upstream SamPredictor.set_image + predict (centre point, multimask_output=True, hq_token_only=False)
  • sam-hq-vit-b load / first call: original 0.77 s / 0.192 s, portable 0.27 s / 0.415 s, kernels 1.06 s / 0.353 s
  • sam-hq-vit-l load / first call: original 1.98 s / 0.205 s, portable 0.76 s / 0.409 s, kernels 1.64 s / 0.403 s
  • sam-hq-vit-h load / first call: original 3.92 s / 0.317 s, portable 1.34 s / 0.518 s, kernels 2.29 s / 0.467 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

One point per ground-truth instance (the interior point farthest from the border); IoU of the best-scored of 3 masks / of the single mask. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
